cohort: 75 parturients undergoing elective caesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anaesthesia
finding: Metaraminol and phenylephrine were non-inferior to norepinephrine in maintaining umbilical arterial pH for hypotension prevention during elective caesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anaesthesia, with metaraminol potentially having a lower hypotension risk and both metaraminol and phenylephrine having a lower hypertension risk compared to norepinephrine.
